Octabam v0.6, built from tag `v0.6` (`5ebdade6`). Octatrack OS 1.40C patched with one of three remixes, `octabam`, `octabam-verbs` or `octabam-bus`; the build runs in the browser on your own copy of 1.40C. The builder page has a **Remix** picker, and each remix has its own overview page and manual.

Build and install: https://sambanks.github.io/octabam/web-builder.html

Changes from v0.5, in all three remixes:
- REMIX SWITCH: the USB controller is reset before the soft reset (#1292), the panel's `60 02` is sent before the reset on an MKI too (#1272), a switch is refused with the DSP stopped, and a short card read is refused with IO ERROR (#1233). Stops after choosing a remix, measured by switching to a remix's own file on an idle MKII: 6 in 22 before the USB reset, 3 in 170 after.
- USB: an attach watchdog restarts the USB session when the controller's session-valid edge was lost (#1293); a USB message between a DIN sender's running-status bytes no longer replaces DIN's running status (#1277); USB MIDI is paused while USB DISK MODE has the card, so files copied off the card no longer come back with a USB-MIDI clock packet over their first 4 bytes (#1264).
- FRAME GUARD's lower edge is 110 µs again (#1295).
- ARR ROW CAP: adding a row at END OF ARR. stops at 256 rows with ROW LIMIT REACHED (#1265). BROWSE PATH GUARD: the sample browser no longer locks up on a file whose full path passes 259 characters (#1269).
- PLOCKS P2: with trigs held, a knob push on an FX1 or FX2 SETUP page 2 toggles that step's page-2 lock (#1275).
- KITS: PTN+FUNC+RIGHT skips a pattern that holds only parameter locks (#1223). COPY PROJECT: SAVE TO NEW copies the old project's sidecar files into the new folder (#1224).
- TEMPLATES: the KIT template carries the SRC pages of STATIC, FLEX, THRU, NEIGHBOR and PICKUP and the AMP pages (#1251). The tabs are KIT, MIDI and PROJECT; the FX tab of #1252 was removed in #1268, and SAVE FX DEFAULT and CLEAR FX DEFAULT stay.
- OCTA303 is v10.0 (#1270; MaMarko): no 11.025 kHz whistle with CUT, RES and ENV high, the VCA no longer clips or wraps, GATE 303's first trig after PLAY sounds, dEVILish FM stays pitched at high RES and ENV, and less ColdFire work for the same output. A FLEX track on a sample named `TB303*` now plays its sample; the OCTA-303 machine is the way in.
- SEQ: RAND avoids a repeated pitch at a reflected DEPTH edge, live audio/MIDI switching is fixed (#1261), and knob D lists the FX page 2 controls (#1235). MORPH is v1.2 (#1209). SCENES P2 writes page-2 scene locks from scene B (#1229).

In `octabam` and `octabam-verbs`: MIDI LOOPBACK with MIDI SCENES, a per-Part DEST of EXT, INT or BOTH on a MIDI track (#1266); SHATTER compensates drive and reduces feedback gain (#1225).
In `octabam`: WAVE's STOP ends the machine's voices (#1232).
In `octabam-verbs`: VERBERATION has real modes, STOP, STOP cuts the tail, AMNT keeps the dry fixed and PRE works at every SIZE (#1234); RESONATOR's pitch controls move to the main page and its limiter range is wider (#1226).
In `octabam-bus`: TEMPO BUS has FUNC+REC copy, FUNC+STOP paste and undo (#1250), and with scene A or B held its window sets scene locks on the bus engines' knobs (#1229).

Measured on Sam's MKII, 27 to 28 Nov 2026, over the cable (`tools/hw/ot_v06.py`; `docs/contributing/HARDWARE_V06.md` has each result):
- The release candidate `OCTABAM R1` (main `5f9e1a1c`, flashed): 12 of 12 switches between three R1 images returned; the `octabam` and `octabam-verbs` matrices ran with no crash, freeze or overload.
- With an image from before each fix as the control: WAVE STOP (#1232), CX OSC FOLD clicks (#1263; not in these remixes), the DISK MODE read of #1264 (79 of 3,306 block reads differed before the fix, 0 after) and OCTA303's whistle (#1270: 20 to 23 dB over its band on v7.1, 4 to 6 dB on v10.0).
- Matched the PR, without a control: VERBERATION AMNT (#1234), MIDI LOOPBACK output for EXT, BOTH and INT (#1266).

Not run on a unit: TEMPO BUS copy, paste and scene locks (#1250, #1229); TEMPLATES (#1251); a switch on an MKI (#1272); the stalled-DSP refusal (#1233); VERBERATION's stop kill, PRE and MODE by ear; `octabam-bus` this round. In the `octabam-verbs` matrix, MODE 2 was flagged for a tail after a single STOP; a double STOP was not tried.

Known:
- Starting USB DISK MODE from the cable (REMOTE's `COMMAND 1`) can refuse after the unit has been idle for a few minutes; a key press on the panel clears it. The cause is not known, and whether the panel's own USB DISK MODE is affected is not known (`docs/contributing/FAILURE_MODES.md`).
- After the fixes, switching a remix still stopped 3 times in 170: a `SYNCING PROJECT` dialog with dead keys, and two stops on the boot screen. A power-cycle clears them.
- #1246: AED froze on open with the browser-built 0.5 image; it did not freeze on a current build on one MKII. The reporter has not confirmed.
- v0.5's fault with MODULATION in T3's block and DARK REV on all 8 tracks was not re-tested.

No Elektron files are attached. The web builder patches are in `docs/site/builder/patches/` in the repository, added after the tag in `0498b239`:
